errorCodes.meaning: The recipient holds no group state for this room. An `open` room has no group and renews with rooms/epoch/mint directly; a sealed room is renewed by the key holder that holds its owner's group.
The recipient holds no authority credential conferring `admin` on this room for its caller, so it cannot advance the room's epoch at the host.
The host is at a different epoch than the recipient's group — another admin advanced the room. Catch up (rooms/epoch/commits) and try again. The host's epoch is carried in `details.hostEpoch`.

The named host could not be resolved, advertises no transport this recipient speaks, or did not answer. `details.stage` says which step went unanswered. At `advance` the outcome of an epoch advance is unknown — the host may have accepted it — so the recipient keeps the pending advance and the next request to it settles it (item 6). At `revocation` an earlier removal's revocation list, delivered again to settle that removal (item 6), went unanswered: the earlier removal stays pending, and nothing of this request was done.

An earlier removal from this room was still pending at the recipient, and when it delivered that removal's revocation list to the host again (item 6, by rooms/owner/group/remove 0.3 item 8) the host refused it. The earlier removal did not take effect: `details.member` is still in the group, and is withdrawn at the host only if `details.listKept` is true and the host ever accepted that list. Nothing of this request was done, and the earlier removal is no longer pending, so repeating this request proceeds; remove `details.member` again if that is still wanted. The host's own code is in `details.code`.

The host answered and declined this request's epoch advance. Nothing was changed. The host's own code is in `details.code`, and its reason in `details.reason`. An earlier removal refused while being settled is `earlierRemovalRefused`, never this code.

reason.description: Why, carried to the host's epoch advance. Untrusted and attributed to its author: it MUST NOT carry personal data or a credential.

roomId.description: The sealed room to renew. The recipient MUST hold its group.
